+    """
+    Recursively merge dictionaries.
+    - Nested dicts are merged recursively
+    - Other values (including None, lists, primitives) are replaced by overrides
+    - Returns a deep copy; inputs are never modified
+
+    Args:
+        defaults: Base dictionary with default values
+        overrides: Dictionary of values to override
+
+    Returns:
+        Merged dictionary as deep copy
+    """
+    # Start with a deep copy of defaults so we don't modify inputs
+    result = deepcopy(defaults)
+
+    for key, value in overrides.items():
+        if (key in result and
+            isinstance(result[key], dict) and
+            isinstance(value, dict)):
+            # Recursively merge nested dictionaries
+            result[key] = merge_settings(result[key], value)
+        else:
+            # Replace with override value (handles None, lists, primitives)
+            result[key] = deepcopy(value)
+
     return result
